chain.limits: Ancestry and patch checks prove code inclusion; semantic contracts are covered separately by review and runtime tests.

command: find app bootstrap config routes database tests /source/scripts -name '*.php' -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

late permission survives real online hydration with one live stream
equivalent Session replacement keeps the existing stream
real account switch during permission stops the stale result before opening another
leaving before permission resolves releases every late track without reopening
denied permission is recoverable by a single explicit retry
hydrated camera captures offline against an already verified signed assignment policy

P1-12: immutable owner-signed media versions survive Garage+Recovery Key without modifying original or inheriting grants

P1-11: two independently verified accounts exchange 1-key E2EE audio grant, recipient decrypts and owner revokes without deleting original

P1-27: owner-signed encrypted Team → durable local queue → server ACL → offline local read

P1-10: offline E2EE video/audio import → 1 MiB Garage chunks → independent recovered owner decrypt
